title: Nuezhenoside G13 from Osmanthus fragrans fruit ameliorates Concanavalin A-induced autoimmune hepatitis by regulating the NF-kappaB/MAPK pathway.
authors: Gao, Ting; Zhang, Meng; Li, Minjie; Wang, Xiaoli; Yao, Wenhan; Shu, Wenjie; Tang, Weizhuo; Zhang, Xiaoshu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究桂花果实中Nuezhenoside G13对自身免疫性肝炎的保护作用及NF-kappaB/MAPK通路机制，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Osmanthus fragrans fruit (OFF) exhibits hepatoprotective function, and it is consumed as food and used in traditional medicine in China. Nuezhenoside G13 (G13) is present in the highest levels in OFF. Autoimmune hepatitis (AIH) is a manifestation of liver disease and seriously endangers health. However, it remains unclear whether G13 affects AIH. AIM OF THE STUDY: To clarify the effect of G13 on AIH and its exact underlying mechanism from a new perspective. MATERIALS AND METHODS: We used a Concanavalin A-induced AIH mouse model and lipopolysaccharide-treated Raw264.7 cells to quantify serum biochemical indicators and confirm whether G13 exhibited protective effects in the AIH mice. Furthermore, we evaluated the effect of G13 via hematoxylin and eosin and immunohistochemical staining. We used enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) and polymerase chain reaction to quantify the inflammatory factors. We confirmed that G13 inhibited apoptosis via terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase dUTP nick end labeling staining. Molecular docking, immunofluorescence, and western blotting experiments of G13 and key proteins of the NF-kappaB/MAPK pathway revealed that G13 alleviated inflammation. In addition, Cell Counting Kit-8, ELISA, NO detection, and western blotting assays were performed. Finally, we used an inhibitor of the p38 MAPK to verify that G13 reduced inflammation through the NF-kappaB/MAPK pathway in Raw264.7 cells. RESULTS: The in vivo experiments revealed that G13 improved oxidative stress and apoptosis. In addition, G13 decreased the expression levels of CD4(+), CD8(+), F4/80(+), and Ly6G and the secretion of inflammatory factors. Interestingly, G13 reduced the phosphorylation levels of IkappaBalpha, NF-kappaB, JNK, ERK1/2, and p38. Additionally, the in vitro experiments revealed that G13 alleviated inflammation through the NF-kappaB/MAPK pathway in lipopolysaccharide-treated Raw264.7 cells. Furthermore, molecular docking demonstrated that the binding fraction of G13 with these proteins was high. CONCLUSION: G13 suppressed oxidative stress, apoptosis, and inflammation in a Concanavalin A-induced AIH mouse model. Furthermore, G13 exerted its effect through the NF-kappaB/MAPK pathway.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：桂花果实（OFF）具有保肝作用，在中国被作为食品食用并用于传统医学。女贞苷G13（G13）在OFF中含量最高。自身免疫性肝炎（AIH）是肝病的一种表现，严重危害健康。然而，G13是否影响AIH尚不清楚。研究目的：从新的角度阐明G13对AIH的作用及其确切潜在机制。材料与方法：我们使用刀豆蛋白A诱导的AIH小鼠模型和脂多糖处理的Raw264.7细胞，量化血清生化指标，并确认G13是否在AIH小鼠中表现出保护作用。此外，我们通过苏木精-伊红染色和免疫组织化学染色评估了G13的效果。我们使用酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）和聚合酶链反应量化炎症因子。我们通过末端脱氧核苷酸转移酶dUTP缺口末端标记染色确认G13抑制了细胞凋亡。对G13及NF-kappaB/MAPK通路关键蛋白的分子对接、免疫荧光和蛋白质印迹实验表明，G13减轻了炎症。此外，还进行了细胞计数试剂盒-8、ELISA、一氧化氮检测和蛋白质印迹实验。最后，我们使用p38 MAPK抑制剂验证G13通过NF-kappaB/MAPK通路在Raw264.7细胞中减少炎症。结果：体内实验显示，G13改善了氧化应激和细胞凋亡。此外，G13降低了CD4(+)、CD8(+)、F4/80(+)和Ly6G的表达水平以及炎症因子的分泌。有趣的是，G13降低了IkappaBalpha、NF-kappaB、JNK、ERK1/2和p38的磷酸化水平。此外，体外实验显示，G13通过NF-kappaB/MAPK通路在脂多糖处理的Raw264.7细胞中减轻了炎症。进一步地，分子对接表明G13与这些蛋白的结合分数较高。结论：G13在刀豆蛋白A诱导的AIH小鼠模型中抑制了氧化应激、细胞凋亡和炎症。此外，G13通过NF-kappaB/MAPK通路发挥其作用。
